_about: Public-domain Zachary Pearce (1690-1774), Bishop of Rochester, for the Word Hoard: A Commentary with Notes on the Four Evangelists and the Acts (London 1777, two volumes) and Sermons on Several Subjects (1778), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

pearce-commentary-1: A Commentary, with Notes, on the Four Evangelists and the Acts of the Apostles, vol. 1 (London, catalogued 1777)
pearce-commentary-2: A Commentary, with Notes, on the Four Evangelists and the Acts of the Apostles, vol. 2 (London, catalogued 1777)

_excluded.pearce-classics: His editions of Cicero and Longinus; the Review of the text of Paradise Lost
